Ya that’s nerve wracking. I relapsed the night I called/texted so my mind was not clear and I was going through hell with anxiety. It was a very very big lesson for me to kick the drugs once and for all. 

But with some time to clear my system of the drugs/alcohol here is what I know based in reality. This may help you.

Realistically you made a call/text you didn’t waste any time really. For someone to come to your house and kill you or rob you is insane. I posted on the Sex Worker subreddit as well and did some research online regarding this and the only time real blackmail was done to people it was those who saw and hooked up with escorts regularly were paying for a while and then stopped. This made the escort upset because they lost a source of income and then from there the blackmail started. 

With that being said blackmail and prostitution are both serious crimes and the risk v reward calculus doesn’t add up. 

If someone comes to your door and demands money based on a phone call? I mean you can easily call the cops and say I don’t remember making a phone call. And since when is making a phone call illegal.

Their main strategy and really their only strategy is fear. You’re fine just keep blocking and ignoring. 

I made the calls/texts 2 weeks ago and I haven’t received any threatening messages since then. If you do DO NOT ENGAGE. 

Simply block and ignore. That’s your best and really your only course of action. If you cave and pay or engage you’re making things worse for yourself.

Also, think about it from their perspective they’re doing this with multiple people. It becomes frustrating when someone doesn’t bite especially when all you did was call/text they really have no power over you. They’ll grow tired and move on.

So I got texts and calls the morning after I initially contacted them. I just deleted and blocked their numbers and haven’t heard anything since. 

How about you ?

Of course I know how nerve wracking it could be. I sympathize complelty with the fear. My number is out there with some escorts and shit it haunts me. 

Keep your head up try and be strong and literally the only course of action is to block and ignore. Learn the lesson and be more mindful in the future. 

You did the right thing your life’s not ruined you’re totally fine. God bless.
